name: Geoffrey Levy
source: Geoffrey is the slacker classmate who's either asleep or playing on his mobile phone in his class. The only times when he's animated is when he's talking to girls or taking foodie pictures for his social media accounts. If he was asked who his best friend was, he would pick Jamie since Jamie cleans up after him.
